errors.text_span: The chart contains fourteen distinct slices representing different news sources, plus a combined “Other” category, for a total of fifteen categories.
errors.evidence: The figure shows 18 slices in total, not 15. The chart includes 18 labeled categories, with multiple 3% slices in addition to the larger ones.

errors.evidence: Several labels, colors, and values are misassigned. In the figure, Breitbart is blue at 14%, Other is gray at 13%, Drudge Report is orange at 8%, The Daily Caller is green at 8%, The Huffington Post is red at 7%, NPR is purple at 6%, Vox is brown at 6%, The Guardian is pink at 5%, BBC is gray at 4%, RT is light green at 3%, Daily Kos is light blue at 3%, National Review is dark blue at 3%, Daily Mail is pink at 3%, Redstate is dark red at 3%, Fox News is navy at 3%, CNN is violet at 3%, Shareblue is magenta at 3%, and PoliticusUSA is dark brown at 3%.

errors.text_span: “Breitbart” (grey, 14%), “Shareblue” (dark grey, 13%), “Other” (light grey, 8%), “The Daily Caller” (green, 8%), “Drudge Report” (teal, 8%), “NPR” (purple, 7%), “Vox” (red, 6%), “The Guardian” (peach, 5%), “BBC” (yellow, 5%), “RT” (blue, 3%), “Daily Kos” (light blue, 3%), “National Review” (salmon, 3%), “Daily Beast” (brown, 3%), “Fox News” (orange, 3%), and “PoliticusUSA” (burgundy, 3%)
errors.evidence: Multiple percentages are wrong: Shareblue is 3%, not 13%; Other is 13%, not 8%; NPR is 6%, not 7%; Vox is 6%, not 6% color-wise but color is wrong; BBC is 4%, not 5%; RT is 3% but the color and label are wrong; the chart also omits several 3% categories and misstates the total set of slices.

errors.text_span: The segments appear ordered clockwise by descending size, starting with “Breitbart.”
errors.evidence: The slices are not described correctly: the chart is arranged around the pie in an anti-clockwise direction in descending order from the top/right area, not clockwise.
The description does not mention that the chart has percentage labels inside the slices, which are visually present and noted in the reference.
